body: manifest.json hardcodes http://localhost:8787/* and https://sync.localhost/*. Adding an app means editing the manifest and rebuilding, which makes the tool unusable for its own purpose (Aman has many apps). Move to optional_host_permissions plus a request flow in the popup. NOTE the trap already paid for: with optional host permissions a webRequest listener registered for <all_urls> logs one warning and then NEVER FIRES — the listener must be re-registered scoped to whatever was actually granted, which is why boot() re-runs on chrome.permissions.onAdded.
title: Host permissions must be a grant flow, not a hardcoded manifest list
